label: Order
caption: MERRICK B. GARLAND, ATTORNEY GENERAL, ET AL. V. JENNIFER VANDERSTOK, ET AL.
text: UPON FURTHER CONSIDERATION of the application of counsel for the applicants, the responses, and the reply filed thereto, IT IS ORDERED that the stay issued on July 28, 2023, is hereby extended until 5 p.m. (EDT) on Tuesday, August 8, 2023.
